WITH california_schools AS (
    SELECT f."School Type",
           COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School) AS "School Name",
           COALESCE(f."School Type", s.SOCType) AS type_for_classification,
           ' ' || LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School), '-', ' '), '.', '')) || ' ' AS name_for_classification,
           s.Latitude
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND s.Latitude IS NOT NULL
), middle_schools AS (
    SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
    FROM california_schools
    WHERE type_for_classification IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
       OR name_for_classification LIKE '% middle %'
       OR name_for_classification LIKE '% intermediate %'
       OR name_for_classification LIKE '% junior high %'
       OR name_for_classification LIKE '% jr high %'
)
SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM middle_schools);

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode,
           s.School AS school_name,
           s.Charter AS charter,
           s.GSserved AS grades_served,
           1.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND (TRIM(s.GSserved) = '12' OR TRIM(s.GSserved) LIKE '%-12')
), top_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, school_name, charter, grades_served, free_meal_rate
    FROM eligible_schools
    WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM eligible_schools)
), sat_totals AS (
    SELECT cds, AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT t.school_name,
       ROUND(t.free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
       CASE t.charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
       t.grades_served,
       CASE
           WHEN a.sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
           WHEN a.sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
           WHEN a.sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
           ELSE 'Above Average'
       END AS sat_performance_level
FROM top_schools AS t
LEFT JOIN sat_totals AS a ON a.cds = t.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.school_name, t.CDSCode;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    SELECT '2010-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
), monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT date(l.CreationDate, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count
    FROM postLinks AS l
    JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
    WHERE l.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND l.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
      AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY date(l.CreationDate, 'start of month')
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(c.post_count, 0)), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts AS c ON c.month_start = m.month_start;

  );

WITH urine AS (
    SELECT ID, TRIM("U-PRO") AS result
    FROM Laboratory
), protein AS (
    SELECT ID,
           CASE
               WHEN SUBSTR(result, 1, 2) = '>=' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(result, 3))
               WHEN SUBSTR(result, 1, 1) = '+'
                    AND INSTR(result, '(') > 2
                    AND SUBSTR(result, -1) = ')'
                    AND SUBSTR(result, 2, INSTR(result, '(') - 2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
               THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(result, INSTR(result, '(') + 1,
                                LENGTH(result) - INSTR(result, '(') - 1))
               ELSE result
           END AS mg_dl
    FROM urine
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM protein AS u
    WHERE u.ID = p.ID
      AND u.mg_dl GLOB '*[0-9]*'
      AND u.mg_dl NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
      AND u.mg_dl NOT GLOB '*.*.*'
      AND CAST(u.mg_dl AS REAL) >= 100
)
ORDER BY p.ID;
